name: web-image-filled-heavy-caps-wordmark-with-purple-liquid-texture
title: White page with the heavy word 'CHAMAAC' filled with a magenta and violet liquid image, dark at the ends and bright in the middle
whatItIs: A pure white frame with a centred heavy sans 'CHAMAAC' whose letters are masked with a glossy purple-magenta fluid image, darker indigo at the outer letters and brighter pink in the middle ones.
whatItMeans: Vivid and modern; image-filled letters make a plain word feel liquid.
techniques: Mask heavy letters with an image.
Let the fill shift in tone across the word.

vocabulary.definition: Letters masked with a photograph or texture.
A gradual change of brightness across a shape.
